text_block_list.text:
After a tumultuous Classic year drew to a 
close, the first day of the Senior year 
had finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... As expected of a shrine on New 
Year's Day. Quite a crowd has gathered, 
hasn't it?
choice_data_list: Aren't you cold dressed like that?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hmph... Can't you tell just by looking?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Of course I'm cold...!
choice_data_list: ...Want me to lend you my jacket?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...I-It's fine for now...! But later... 
you must give it to me without fail..."

While I was worrying over King Halo's 
condition as her legs trembled slightly...

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, did you see? Did you see?! The 
New Year's news!

text_block_list.name: Accompanying Guest
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I saw that. Special Week and Seiun Sky 
are seriously running in the Tenno Sho 
(Spring), right?

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor
text_block_list.text: No, no! That's not what I meant—

text_block_list.name: Accompanying Guest
text_block_list.text:
Then is it El Condor Pasa's overseas 
stories? Or maybe Grass Wonder's—

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor
text_block_list.text: I told you, you're wrong! Ah—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph, looks like everyone's finally 
starting to notice.

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor
text_block_list.text:
Look, look! It's that rich girl!! From 
that trending #1 news article online!

text_block_list.name: Accompanying Guest
text_block_list.text:
"...'A sudden change of course—is the 
young lady losing her way?!' It's true. 
That's the girl right over there. I mean, 
what is she even wearing right now? It's 
crazy."

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! Whoa! If I take a picture with 
her, do you think it'd go viral?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hey. Trainer, did you know? Interest beats 
indifference.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
In whatever shape or form, the one who 
belongs in the spotlight is me. I will lay 
whatever groundwork is necessary for that.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'm fully prepared for whatever they might 
say. Even so, I will keep heading straight 
for the center of everyone's attention.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu. A first-rate Umamusume captivates 
people because she keeps her head up and 
chest held high at all times."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Now then...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Everyone!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I am none other than the first-rate 
Umamusume, King Halo! I look forward to 
working with you again this year!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I shall grant permission for photographs 
today as a special exception! However, 
keep it within reason! Make sure you do 
not cause trouble for others!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
By the way, I'm about to get moving. 
Anyone who wants a photo together, come 
along with me.

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Really!? Maybe I should go too!!

text_block_list.name: Accompanying Guest
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey! ...Well, whatever. I'm gonna go 
take some pictures too.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, everyone. Make sure to take cute 
photos of me, okay?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. I suppose that's the end of 
taking two-shots with everyone.

...Astoundingly, she managed to see the 
photo session through with hundreds of 
people.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... That was truly exhausting. Quite 
an elaborate setup, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to the moment this 
blossoms. Yes, at the Takamatsunomiya 
Kinen—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...*achoo*!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
My, aren't you thoughtful♪ I was just 
getting thirsty, in fact.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... But one bottle isn't going to cut 
it. King is utterly exhausted, throat and 
body alike.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"So, I'll grant you the right to walk with 
me to that vending machine over there to 
buy one."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Come on, go buy one for yourself too. 
You must be freezing after waiting around 
for so long."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Bring some tea for those girls too, 
please. Since we're all here, let's have a 
New Year's tea party tonight!

And after catching our breath with a cup 
of warm tea, we spent the rest of the New 
Year's holidays.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you remembered after all, didn't 
you?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
And with that, hand it over quickly! It 
was seriously freezing out there!!
King Halo stripped me of my jacket!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! If you want it back, you'll have 
to catch up to me first!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, by the way, the usual New Year's party 
starts at 19:00!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I'll even grant you the right to prepare 
for it! Ohohoho! Ohohoho!"

And with my jacket still in her clutches, 
she sprinted off at full speed...

Flushed red, she ran at a speed that felt 
like it just might have broken her 
personal best record.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaah?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, delete that photo this instant! 
Right away! Now! Hurry!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
If the public ever saw me caught off guard 
mid-sneeze, the King's approval rating 
would plummet instantly!
choice_data_list:
Being cute might boost your approval 
rating!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Of course I won't, you klutz! Did you lose 
a screw in your head or something!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Honestly, hand over that phone!
...And the photo was deleted.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Geez! If you wanted to take photos that 
badly, I'll let you take as many as you 
want tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, say cheese! Who's a first-rate 
Umamusume~?

text_block_list.name: Entourage
text_block_list.text: Kiiing!

...And the next day, I found myself 
attending her party as her dedicated 
photographer.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Geez! Focus, Trainer! Right now, you are 
my cameraman!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"And I'm a top-tier model! Come on, let's 
do one more shot from this angle!"

And so, it felt like... they had both 
honed their skills with each other.
